subject: ZenWave segmented retention & deletion evidence request
messages:
From: Marta Perez <marta.perez@zenwave.health>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Lopez <alex.lopez@zenwave.health>, legal@zenwave.health
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Segmented retention and deletion evidence request

Hi Jonas / Stephanie,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG assessment and an upcoming regulator spot-check, we need evidence that Redwood can: (1) apply different retention windows by tenant/environment and (2) produce verifiable deletion certificates for sampled records (both logs and application-level artifacts).

High-level asks:
- A short (1 page) attestation describing how segmented retention policies are configured and enforced (per-tenant, per-environment).
- A sampling plan to produce deletion certificates for three sample datasets (IDs included below).
- Instructions for secure export of logs for forensic review (S3 presigned export preferred).

Regulatory constraints: one dataset (Batch ID BW-942) is currently on legal hold until 2026-12-15 — we should not delete that data, but we still need evidence of retention/hold handling.

Attachments: ZenWave provided a short request PDF with dataset IDs.

Can you confirm feasibility and an estimated delivery date? We need initial artifacts by 2026-12-07.

— Marta
Marta Perez
Head of Compliance, ZenWave Health

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Perez <marta.perez@zenwave.health>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Segmented retention and deletion evidence request

Marta — thanks for the clear ask. We can support this. Quick summary of what we'll produce:
- A 1-page attestation for segmented retention (per-tenant/environment controls + config sources).
- A concrete sampling plan (redwood_log-sampling-plan_v1.xlsx) that maps your three sample dataset IDs to retention checks and deletion-proof artifacts (deletion event hashes + export snapshots).
- Step-by-step S3 export instructions for secure forensic transfers (we'll provide presigned URL guidance).

Questions:
1) For the datasets you want certificates for, do you want us to perform deletion on our side (and then provide certificates) or do you want the artifacts exported to you for verification and then we keep records of deletion?
2) For BW-942 (legal hold) — confirm that this one should be excluded from any deletion and only included as "held" evidence.

Proposed timeline: initial artifacts by 2026-12-01 (drafts), formal evidence pack by 2026-12-06. If you need the final by 12-07 we can aim for 12-06.

I'm attaching the sampling plan draft and will loop Marissa for formal evidence checklists and signatures.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Marta Perez <marta.perez@zenwave.health>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Lopez <alex.lopez@zenwave.health>, legal@zenwave.health
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Segmented retention and deletion evidence request

Jonas — thanks, that timeline works. To clarify on your questions:
- We'd like Redwood to perform deletion for two non-held datasets and provide deletion certificates (hash of deleted object, timestamp, and operator ID). For one dataset we will pull exported snapshots and verify independently (we'll tell you which one).
- Confirmed on BW-942: legal hold; exclude from deletion but provide evidence of hold (audit entry + retention policy mapping).

Also: please include an example of the deletion certificate format you plan to use (JSON or PDF). For exports, we prefer encrypted S3 presigned URLs; our security team will pull them into a temporary bucket in our account.

If possible, include a short note on retention TTLs for ephemeral logs vs. persistent audit logs — our SIG assessor will look specifically for differences by log type.

Thanks — attaching a small CSV with the three dataset IDs we mentioned.

— Marta

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Perez <marta.perez@zenwave.health>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Segmented retention and deletion evidence request

Hi Marta / team — looping in Redwood Compliance to formalize the deliverables.

Actionable checklist we'll provide:
- Segmented retention attestation (PDF) showing policy table, config source (policy ID), and enforcement mechanism.
- Deletion certificate template (PDF + example JSON payload).
- Sampling plan (Jonas' spreadsheet) + mapping to log stores and S3 prefixes.
- Forensics export instructions (presigned URL workflow + encryption guidelines).
- Audit trail export showing operator IDs and timestamps for any deletion or hold operations.

We will NOT delete BW-942 due to legal hold; instead we'll provide a hold evidence bundle (audit record + policy link). Please confirm acceptance of the checklist. Once confirmed I will prepare the attestation and cert templates and upload to a shared Drive (link below).

Drive (working folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cZENWAVE-evidence
Expected delivery: draft evidence pack 2026-12-01, final 2026-12-06.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Staff, Compliance & Customer Evidence | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Perez <marta.perez@zenwave.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, legal@zenwave.health
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Segmented retention and deletion evidence request

Marta — thanks for confirming and thanks Marissa for the checklist. Next steps from Redwood:
1) We'll place draft artifacts in the Drive folder by EOD 2026-12-01 (attestation PDF, deletion-certificate-example.json, sampling spreadsheet).
2) For the two datasets you asked us to delete, we'll perform deletion in our staging environment first and provide a deletion certificate (human-reviewed) for your records. We'll then schedule the production deletion during a mutually agreeable change window and provide final certificates.
3) For BW-942 we'll attach the hold evidence bundle (audit log export + policy mapping).

Attachments included here for your review: redwood_log-sampling-plan_v1.xlsx, s3_export_instructions.pdf

Please confirm if you prefer deletion certificates as signed PDFs or as signed JSON blobs (we can produce both; PDFs are easier for legal ingestion).

If everything looks good we'll proceed to schedule the deletion in production for 2026-12-08 (morning UTC) pending final sign-off from ZenWave legal.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: redwood_log-sampling-plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), s3_export_instructions.pdf (PDF)
